data.name: Black Gemstone
data.description: As you pick up the stone, it shines in your hand. You look into the darkness of the gem, you lose yourself for a moment. A single swirl of black smoke comes out, the gemstone sings to you another riddle:  "Winds that whisper the final breath, Hands that grasp in cold of death. He who walks where spirits weep, Once sealed, now rising from his sleep. A master of the veil unseen, A king of souls, cruel and keen."

data.description: A net just big enough to catch some clown sized humans. Or ninja.
data.battleDescription: The moment the net is thrown, everything stops. The clown does not laugh. He screams. “NO—NOT THE NET! YOU—YOU’RE HIM! The one from the scrolls… the Hunter of Humor!” His form begins to shrink, folding in on itself as the net tightens. He whimpers. He pleads. And then… he vanishes into smoke. The Kage Hat drops silently to the ground. From within its folds rolls a small, glittering object — pulsing with chaotic chakra.
